per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Normal UI interactions such as navigation, search, and simple forms shall respond to user actions within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Payment processing shall complete within 15 seconds under normal operating conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Initial streaming startup buffering shall complete within 10 seconds (excluding unavoidable user network latency).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The streaming player shall implement adaptive bitrate streaming that starts at a lower bitrate on weak connections and ramps up, and provide a low-quality fallback for very poor links.
System availability shall target 99.5% uptime over a rolling 12-month period.
Account creation flow from landing page to a usable account shall not exceed four pages/steps for novice users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product shall be usable by approximately 90% of novice users (users who can browse social media but not complex flows).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Credit card details and sensitive customer records stored on our servers shall be encrypted at rest and accessible only to authorized personnel per defined role-based access controls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Program admins shall have broad access for troubleshooting, while support staff shall only see non-sensitive customer data (order history, contact info) and not full card numbers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Evaluate and decide between server-side encrypted storage of card data and tokenization via a payment gateway, favoring tokenization to reduce PCI compliance burden where possible.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall detect suspicious activity (e.g., repeated failed logins, credential stuffing, suspicious card activity), log events for review, and trigger alerts when thresholds are crossed.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Alerts for security/abuse events shall be obvious and hard to miss: baseline notifications via email, with severe events also sent via SMS or pushed to an admin dashboard; thresholds must be defined to avoid alert fatigue.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Errors shall be handled gracefully: user-facing messages must explain what happened and provide retry steps or contact support; payment errors must show clear messages (no cryptic codes); streaming errors must offer retry or quality switch options; incidents shall be logged for admin diagnosis.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Accessibility shall follow W3C standards (semantic HTML, ARIA where needed) and be treated as a must-have for assistive technologies.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website will comply with W3C standards.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Admins shall be able to generate pre-paid cards in bulk via an API or scheduled job and the system shall enforce redemption tracking to prevent reuse.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Provide actionable analytics dashboards for business users (revenue over time, top titles, redemption rates) that are performant and useful on day one (not full BI).
Provide an easy moderation queue for flagged reviews, and allow users to flag inappropriate content.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support iterative usability testing with representative users from target regions to validate usability claims and guide improvements.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Operations shall have written SLAs and targets documented for response times (sub-5s for normal pages, ~15s for payments, ~10s for streaming buffering) and availability (99.5%).
